title: The ordinary and derived restricted regular coefficient pullback
statement: For a morphism a:R→S of commutative condensed rings and f:X→Y, define regularPullback₀ by comapUpperStarIso.symm at the regular S-module followed by restriction of the inverse strong-monoidal unit comparison. Define regularPullback:L(R,f)(B(a,Y))≅B(a,X) by the canonical exact-left-derived comparison, the localization and single-complex comparisons, and regularPullback₀. These use the functors and coefficients of [def-sfb-internal-derived-scalar-comparisons].
